item.title: SHEMM Coach
item.description: Today, let's talk Medication. Taking it consistently is a habit, and habits work best when they're tied to something you already do every day. Look at your routine and pick one fixed anchor, like your morning meditation. If you ever miss a dose, don't guess or double up. Check your instructions or ask your pharmacist. Consistency beats perfection. Action: tie your medication to one daily anchor, starting today.
